about: What happens in SharePoint over the weekend. sharepoint.py apply <id> replays one event on the workspace copy. Each event changes files, the register, or both.

events.title: Finance publishes the 2026 Expense Policy
events.story: A new consolidated policy, effective 1 November 2026, replaces the 2023 policy and its 2024 update. The old two are kept, marked superseded.

events.title: HR edits the Leave Policy
events.story: Carry-over goes from 5 to 10 days, and the public holidays and unpaid leave sections move to the HR portal. The file gets shorter.

events.title: Legal withdraws the Q3 planning notes
events.story: The notes named people in a hiring discussion. Legal deletes the file from SharePoint.

events.title: HR fixes who can read the salary bands
events.story: The salary bands were shared with every employee by mistake. HR restricts them to HR and people managers. Not one word of the file changes.

set.note: Fixed: restricted to HR and managers.

events.title: Someone edits the wiki page footer
events.story: The copyright year and a navigation link change. The article itself does not.
